items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So this little career I have, having a big band, is because Gunnar, my man, he basically takes care of it.

ctx.x: And now, thanks to Thad Jones, you can be a lead soprano.

Yes, but if you’re not lead, you got to follow somebody else’s phrasing. That’s not – I couldn’t do it. I just couldn’t musically do it. I would get bored. I don’t have the m.o. to be in a big band, be in a section, and not solo. I’m sorry. That’s the way it goes. I couldn’t do it, and I cannot write it. So this little career I have, having a big band, is because Gunnar, my man, he basically takes care of it. He’s my man.
This is a good chance to talk about Gunnar Mossblad a little bit, isn’t it?
